browser_verification.details: Three new Playwright tests in e2e/sequencer.spec.ts, each verified to FAIL against the pre-fix sources (git stash of src/engine/scheduler.ts, src/ui/playhead.ts, src/main.ts) and PASS after. (1) Playhead audio-time sync: instruments the live event bus, correlating engine:trigger.time (the step's AudioContext time) against ctx.currentTime at engine:step delivery; measured lead fell from 49-91ms (median 83ms) pre-fix to single-digit ms post-fix, asserted < 30ms. (2) Stale column: a phrase-view switch mid-playback left a 42-cell column lit indefinitely and through Stop; now asserts zero .playing cells off-view and after Stop. (3) Playing-phrase marker: asserted zero marked at rest, exactly the playing slot during playback, zero after Stop; pre-fix it was never marked in any state because setOnPhraseChange() had no caller. Full suite: 74/74 passing.
